item.title: Smiling Rocks strengthens UK presence with key independent retail partnerships
item.description: Retail Jeweller Smiling Rocks strengthens UK presence with key independent retail partnerships Laboratory grown diamond jewellery brand Smiling Rocks is accelerating its UK expansion, securing distribution with a growing roster of independent retail partners following its official market launch last year. Smiling Rocks strengthens UK presence with key independent retail partnerships Ruth Faulkner

item.title: Betts Group brings net zero Bellevue Mine gold to UK via Titcombe Bespoke Jewellery
item.description: Retail Jeweller Betts Group brings net zero Bellevue Mine gold to UK via Titcombe Bespoke Jewellery The Betts Group has supplied the UK’s first batch of Single Mine Origin fine gold grain from the Bellevue Mine in Western Australia, with award winning independent Titcombe Bespoke Jewellery becoming the inaugural retail recipient. Betts Group brings net zero Bellevue Mine gold to UK via Titcombe Bespoke Jewellery Ruth Faulkner

item.title: SaferGems warns jewellers over rise in Apple Pay refund fraud
item.description: Retail Jeweller SaferGems warns jewellers over rise in Apple Pay refund fraud Jewellers across the UK are being urged to remain vigilant following a sharp rise in Apple Pay refund fraud, an emerging criminal tactic now impacting the wider retail sector, including jewellery businesses. SaferGems warns jewellers over rise in Apple Pay refund fraud Ruth Faulkner

item.title: Tasaki launches first-ever all-metal jewellery collection designed by Thakoon Panichgul
item.description: Retail Jeweller Tasaki launches first-ever all-metal jewellery collection designed by Thakoon Panichgul Japanese jewellery house Tasaki has unveiled its first-ever Metal Jewellery Collection, marking a new chapter for the brand’s design direction and expanding its iconic balance and danger horn series into all-metal creations. Tasaki launches first-ever all-metal jewellery collection designed by Thakoon Panichgul Ruth Faulkner

item.title: From Transparency to Transaction: PGI’s digital product passports
item.description: Retail Jeweller From Transparency to Transaction: PGI’s digital product passports The Platinum Guild Circle hopes to grow sales for jewellery retailers with the introduction of Digital Product Passports. Ruth Faulkner speaks to Platinum Guild International chief executive Tim Schlick and head of global business development Phil Romans to find out more. From Transparency to Transaction: PGI’s digital product passports Ruth Faulkner

item.title: INDUSTRY Q&A: Falling demand for 18K gold jewellery in the UK
item.description: Retail Jeweller INDUSTRY Q&A: Falling demand for 18K gold jewellery in the UK Jewellery writer Haig Ter-Martirosian speaks to bespoke jewellery designer Andrew Geoghegan about the pressures reshaping the demand for 18k gold jewellery in this country. INDUSTRY Q&A: Falling demand for 18K gold jewellery in the UK Haig Ter-Martirosian

item.title: Bright New Gems marks 20th anniversary with alumni exhibition at Goldsmiths’ Centre
item.description: Retail Jeweller Bright New Gems marks 20th anniversary with alumni exhibition at Goldsmiths’ Centre Emerging talent initative Bright New Gems will celebrate its 20th anniversary with a one-day pop-up exhibition and panel discussion at the Goldsmiths’ Centre in London on 3 March 2026, bringing together more than 50 alumni from across the programme’s two-decade history. Bright New Gems marks 20th anniversary with alumni exhibition at Goldsmiths’ Centre Ruth Faulkner

item.title: Lisa Angel to make Northern debut at Victoria Leeds
item.description: Retail Jeweller Lisa Angel to make Northern debut at Victoria Leeds Independent jewellery and accessories retailer Lisa Angel is set to make its Northern debut at Victoria Leeds, after signing for a new store at Victoria Gate. Lisa Angel to make Northern debut at Victoria Leeds Ruth Faulkner

item.title: Jewellers of the JQ “Meet the Experts” event hailed a success
item.description: Retail Jeweller Jewellers of the JQ “Meet the Experts” event hailed a success The Jewellers of the JQ “Meet the Experts” event, a collaboration between National Association of Jewellers and Mastermelt, has been described as a resounding success after attracting more than 100 professionals and students from across the trade. Jewellers of the JQ “Meet the Experts” event hailed a success Ruth Faulkner

item.title: Nima Jewellers launches precision cut laboratory grown diamond jewellery range for UK retailers
item.description: Retail Jeweller Nima Jewellers launches precision cut laboratory grown diamond jewellery range for UK retailers Nima Jewellers has announced the launch of a new laboratory grown diamond jewellery range for UK retailers, featuring GCAL by Sarine 8X precision diamond cutting technology.
